bio.text: Collin Corbett is an independent candidate for governor of Illinois in 2026 and lives in Palatine, and filed petitions on May 26, 2026.
Corbett is a former Republican political strategist and the founder of the consulting firm Cor Strategies, which has helped Republican candidates, and left the firm following the primary.
The running mate is Carolyn Schofield of Crystal Lake, a former Republican McHenry County Board member.

sources.title: Former Republican strategist Collin Corbett files to run for governor as independent
